entities.summary: Yuri Alekseyevich Ryzhov was a Soviet and Russian scientist in the field of fluid dynamics, political and social activist, diplomat, Doctor of Technical Sciences (1970), member of the Russian Academy of Sciences, former Russian Ambassador to France (1992-1998).
